content.comment_body: Hello [user_name], I’ve just installed [version_no] of [product_name] and haven’t used it before. Is it not possible to use it as intended? I’m noticing many problems—specifically, the parameter options for assigning variables to buttons aren’t showing up. This is my first time programming with [product_name], aiming to set up a control gate. The location only has electricity and internet via wireless, since it’s in the mountains. I’m planning to use a router with a SIM card. Is it possible to connect through AWS? My hardware version is [version_no].
I don’t use AWS. I work with [product_name] [version_no] to build custom web pages for my local network and haven’t encountered any issues in that scenario.
Thank you, [user_name]. I’ll keep investigating to see if I can apply this setup at a site with internet access.

analysis.insight_summary: One user is running into serious usability issues with [product_name], mainly that options for variable assignment to buttons are missing, making remote control difficult. The user is unsure whether connecting hardware for remote control through cloud services like AWS is feasible, especially when only wireless internet is available. A second user shares that [product_name] works well for local web interfaces, implying the main problem is with cloud connectivity or initial setup process.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a straightforward way to assign variables to web editor buttons and to use the software for reliable remote hardware control via the cloud.
